verification: JSDOM UI event checks only; native dragging, visual rendering and Windows integration not verified

checks.name: Highlight preserves exact raw text, empty and duplicate elements, and escapes markup
Whole-string highlights only exact matches; blanks are not matched as list elements
Workbench highlights just the selected Path element, leaving other elements unmarked
Workbench double click opens shared editor with raw values and demo metadata
Edit, move, add and delete stay in draft; cancel restores focus and snapshot
Explicit workbench edit button provides a discoverable alternative
Windows table shows snapshot without scheme highlights and shares the direct editor
Keyboard entry and Escape close editor without changing demo data
Empty segments, repeated values and whitespace survive the editor unchanged
Keyboard ordering retains stable row identity and input focus
Drag/drop event handlers reorder elements without deduplication
Separator validation prevents ambiguous element input while retaining typed text
Apply updates only demo snapshot, keeps raw order, and records a demo history item
Deleting all elements removes the Windows value rather than persisting an empty string
Special value stays whole with semicolons and hides element sorting controls
All schemes copy is simple and group headings separate name, count and flags
Shared component and additional stylesheet are local; no UI runtime errors
